text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/disburse_cycle2.py (P1): an ops script that loads active households, checks is_eligible, and for each eligible household calls disburse(household.id, 60, payment_key(household.id, 2)), then queues a PAYMENT_SENT SMS (ValueError, e.g. sms_ok False, is caught and does not abort the run). It reports how many cycle-2 payments already exist via sent_payments() before sending, and DuplicatePayment on re-run guarantees exactly-once payment. Ran it once (P2): 19 eligible households were each paid exactly one 60-dollar cycle-2 payment (PAY-00018 through PAY-00036), with SMS queued for all except HH-13137 and HH-14605 (no SMS consent). A verification re-run paid 0 new payments, confirming idempotency; no ineligible household was paid.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
